title: Ingredient
description: One file in ingredients/: a registered ingredient with the package defaults the desktop app uses. The file stem must be lowercase snake_case.

name.description: The name exactly as recipes refer to it in their measurements.

default_package_unit.description: How a package is described, e.g. 'heads' or '(16 oz.) packages'.

portions_text.description: How a 'portions' unit of this ingredient reads on the site, e.g. 'cloves'.
